chartConfig: Telescopic boom 9.2-30 m, 5.5 t counterweight (max), outriggers extended (6.305 x 6.028 m per dimension drawing), 360°, standard (non-telescoping) capacities

source.title: Liebherr Technical data - Mobile crane LTM 1030-2.1 [m/t] (liebherr-200-ltm-1030-2-1-td-200-02-defisr02-2023, linked from liebherr.com product page)

notes: Values from the official Liebherr metric datasheet (upper table on p.8: 360°, 5.5 t). Each boom length has two sub-columns: 9.2 m has an over-rear '*' column (35 t at 3 m = headline rating) and a 360° column; the other boom lengths have a standard column and a '**' telescopable-load column. Only the 360° standard columns are stored. Datasheet has only the max (5.5 t) and 2.3 t counterweight 360° tables; outrigger span is not printed on the table (icon only), full span taken from the dimension drawing (VarioBase: 2.328-6.028 m transverse). Max supporting force 300 kN (30.6 t) from crane data p.7. Operating weight not stated: on-road gross weight ≤ 24 t (2 x 12 t) with 2.3 t counterweight (p.6). maxHookHeight not taken (only a lifting-height graph, p.10). Overall length incl. superstructure/boom overhang 10.310 m; tail radius R = 3150 mm (top view). Dims from the side/top dimension drawing: overallLength_m = carrier length (bottom dimension chain, carrier front to rear); axle positions and slew centre are cumulative sums of that chain, measured from the carrier front. Height/width = columns A/B-or-C of the dimension table for the standard 385/95 R 25 (14.00 R 25) tyres. wheelDiameter_m is NOT from the drawing: nominal value computed from the tyre designation (25 in rim + 2 x 95% x 385 mm = 1.37 m). Boom pivot height/offset are not dimensioned on the drawing (null). Liebherr remarks: hook block weight is part of the load (chartIncludesHookBlock true). Dimension reference corrected: the datasheet's bottom dimension chain starts at the front of the boom head (transport position, boom overhanging the cab), not at the carrier front bumper. overallLength_m is now the carrier length (front bumper to rear) and axlePositions_m / slewCentreFromFront_m are measured from the carrier front bumper; the boom head overhang ahead of the bumper is stored as boomOverhangFront_m = 1.624 m (overall transport length incl. boom = 10.158 m). Evidence (dimensions drawing p.3): bottom chain 1624 | 2886 | 3580 | 2068 = 10158 with separate 8534 carrier dimension; slew centre 2650 behind 1st axle.
